description: List the kinds of rule Juriset publishes. Each entry has its slug (the `rule_type` argument of the other tools), domain, description, how jurisdiction levels combine (`override`, `max` or `stack`) and the JSON Schema of its `data`, with every field described. Examples: `minimum_wage` and `overtime` (domain `employment`). Optional `domain` filter. Reads the registry; no rule lookup.

domain.description: Only this domain's rule types, e.g. `employment` or `payroll`.

name: list_rule_types
title: List rule types
